messages:
tara: spotted a flaky onboarding demo: duplicate order records when 429 + token refresh coincide. quick log: `retrying request 429 after token refresh, idempotency header missing`.

tara: sample-app (python) doesn't set Idempotency-Key; node sample does. this leads to duplicate side-effects on retries.

leo: thanks. is payload changing between attempts? any timestamps/nonces?

tara: yes, server adds `created_at` and client attaches `nonce` sometimes. body hash dedupe fails.

anika: for onboarding docs we should recommend derived idempotency keys: business_id + client_nonce or stable fields. fallback to UUID when nothing stable.

leo: agree. propose SDK behavior: auto-insert header for non-streaming POSTs if absent. but allow override. file = sdk/issue-derive-idempotency.

tara: also need jittered backoff for 429s. current linear retry floods demo webhook when many clients refresh at once. simple algo: `delay = base * 2**attempt + random(0, base)`

anika: add a short demo webhook guard too: if Idempotency-Key seen return 200 no-op. cheap safety for demos and sample tenants.

ci-bot: created issue: RED-DEVEX-1423 1: sdk parity: auto-idempotency + 429 jitter.

leo: I'll prep a tiny integration test: simulate token rotate between attempt 0 and 1, inject 429 on first retry, assert webhook receives only one create for same idempotency key.

tara: PR incoming to sample-app with derived-key example and docs snippet. will include python helper `make_idempotency_key(payload, stable_fields)`

anika: note for release notes: mention sample-app change and best-practice for customers.

leo: minor UX callout: surface a warning in our quickstart if SDK auto-added idempotency header so devs know they can override it.

tara: thanks all. prioritizing this to avoid demo regressions. will post PR link when ready.
